title: Cookie Policy | KivoReach
description: The one cookie and the browser storage the KivoReach website uses, what each is for, how long it lasts and how to remove it.

blocks.html: Last updated: 18 November 2026. This page is a draft and is not yet published.
The website uses one cookie and a little storage in your browser. It does not use analytics, advertising or tracking cookies.

blocks.caption: Cookies and browser storage
rows: A random ID, signed so it cannot be forged, used to count free tool runs
Remembers your light, dark or automatic theme
Remembers when your free runs refresh, to show a countdown
Until the runs refresh or you clear it

blocks.html: The Cloudflare security check that protects the tools and forms may also use technical data in your browser to tell people from automated traffic; see Cloudflare's own privacy information.

blocks.title: For legal review
blocks.html: Confirm whether a consent banner is needed in the countries the site targets. Strictly necessary storage is usually exempt from consent, but the Cloudflare check and any future additions should be reviewed.
You can delete cookies and site data in your browser settings at any time. If you delete amk_vid, the website gives you a new ID next time you use a tool.
If we add any cookie or storage, we will list it here before it is used. More detail is in the Privacy Policy.
